title: Ant International-SRE Engineer (US)-Americas & EMEA Tech
description:
AUS Merchant Service.INC as known as Alipay that is committed to democratizing payment services and empowering people and businesses to join and thrive in the global economy. Alipay at its core is a group of engineers that are dedicated in building cutting edge, highly reliable, highly scalable and high throughput payment system. Here at Ant Group, you will have a positive impact to the world. You will learn and build the most exciting and most capable large-scale payment system with engineers like you with passion. A career at Alipay is more than just a job. It’s a chance to have broader knowledge and learn things from all aspects of how to make payments happen. At Alipay, we value personal growth and always set higher bar, encourage people to come out of comfort zone and make yourself a better you. You can expect to be constantly challenged with interesting technical problems. Our work environment is collaborative, innovative, results-driven, and completely focused on the customer.

AUS Merchant Service.INC North American Technology team is looking for a talented, creative, and passionate software engineer to help build a cutting-edge and innovative payment system to solve our merchant and consumer needs. As a self-motivated and enthusiastic member of our team, you will work with extremely talented peers in a fun environment building performance efficient payment authorization services that are highly scalable, configurable and available. You will be encouraged to innovate and move in a fast pace to deliver solution to our customers.

Responsibilities:
● Design and develop solutions to automate the technical operations of large-scale systems, and work closely with teams to improve stability from a Software Development Lifecycle perspective.
● Take the technical effort to strengthen payment system stability, which includes but not limited to the monitoring, logs, dashboard, diagnosis tools etc.; conduct usual drills and develop remedy plans to achieve fast service restoration, and take shifts to respond to production issues across regions.
● Define the indicators to evaluate the performance and runtime of the system to improve the observability, facilitating system development and trouble-shooting process; and, plan the system capacities according to business expansion and scheduled promotions.
● Analyze the production cases, such as performance bottleneck, to conclude the technical best-practices, taking the efforts to achieve the high-availability payment architecture.
● Designing and setting up new IDC; designing and implementing data protection plan to meet the standard requirement.

Qualifications:
● Bachelor's / Master's Degree in Computer Science-related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience; with 2 years of working experience in Internet industry preferred;
● Solid knowledge of Computer Science, and familiar with the principles of Operating System (Unix/Linux), Computer Storage, Computer Networking and other related principles.
● Software development experience in at least one programming language, such as Java/Python;
● The strong ability to resolve system problems, good communication skills and a sense of ownership.
● The experiences of Redis, MySQL, Nginx, Kubernetes, Docker/Containers, Function as a service, RPC Framework, and Service Mesh, etc.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is  $100,000-150,000.  Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Ant International and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and relevant education or training.
Additional benefits for this role may include: company bonus,  401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits etc.

title: Ant International-Business Development Manage-U.S. Offline Payments
description:
About Antom
Antom is redefining how merchants accept payments and grow their businesses. As a global fintech leader under Ant International, we power commerce across 200+ markets, connecting merchants to consumers through unified payments, AI driven risk tools, and smart terminal solutions.
Now, we’re bringing that innovation to the United States.
We’re launching our U.S. offline payments channel, starting with SMB merchants in personal care (nail salons, spas) and auto repair services—two industries ready for modern, flexible, and global ready payment experiences. If you want to help build something new, bold, and high impact, this is your moment.

What Makes This Role Special
This isn’t just another sales job.
This is your chance to shape Antom’s U.S. market entry and bring a world class payments ecosystem—card acceptance, terminals, and Alipay+ mobile wallets—to underserved SMBs.
You’ll be the face of Antom in the field, the voice of the merchant inside the company, and the catalyst for our U.S. growth story.

What You Will Do
Drive Merchant Acquisition
• Travel within your territory to introduce Antom’s offline payments and terminal solutions to SMB merchants.
• Proactively source leads, build your pipeline, and convert merchants through a full end to end sales cycle.
• Conduct discovery, demos, pricing discussions, and contract negotiation with small business owners.
Act as a Strategic Consultant
• Tailor payment solutions that help nail salons, spas, and auto repair shops operate more efficiently and grow revenue.
• Educate merchants on Antom’s U.S. card acceptance, smart terminals, and global mobile wallet capabilities.
Build and Lead Referral Partnerships
• Develop and manage strategic referral relationships with:
• Independent Sales Organizations (ISOs)
• Independent Software Vendors (ISVs)
• Centers of Influence (COIs) such as local business associations, equipment suppliers, and community networks
• Create partner enablement strategies that drive consistent lead flow and merchant adoption.
• Represent Antom at partner events, trade shows, and local business gatherings.
Collaborate and Influence
• Work cross functionally with product, operations, and risk teams to ensure seamless merchant onboarding.
• Provide market intelligence and merchant feedback to shape Antom’s U.S. product roadmap.
Own Your Targets
• Meet and exceed monthly merchant acquisition, activation, and revenue goals.
• Maintain accurate pipeline reporting and forecasting.

What You Need to Have
• Experience in a quota driven, self sourced sales environment.
• Demonstrated success in cold calling, prospecting, and building your own pipeline.
• Strong communication and relationship building skills with SMB owners.
• Ability to thrive in a fast moving, startup like launch environment.
• High School Diploma or GED. Relevant collegiate degree preferred.

What Would Be Great to Have
• 3+ years of experience in payments, POS, merchant services, or SMB sales.
• Experience selling into personal care or auto service verticals.
• Experience developing referral partnerships with ISOs, ISVs, or COIs.
• Bachelor’s degree or military experience.
• Proven ability to design strategies that drive pipeline growth and revenue.

Compensation & Benefits
Antom offers a competitive and comprehensive compensation package, including:
• Competitive base salary
• Full medical benefits
• 401(k) plan
• Meal plan
• And much more

Why Join Antom
• Be part of the U.S. launch of one of the world’s most advanced payment platforms.
• Sell a differentiated solution combining card acceptance, smart terminals, and global mobile wallets.
• Work with a global fintech leader trusted by merchants in 200+ markets.
• Grow your career in a high impact role with massive upside.
• Join a team that values innovation, ownership, and merchant success.

The OTE of this position is around $150,000 - $300,000.

The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire base salary for the position across our US office locations. Individual pay is determined by a number of factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education and training.

title: Ant International-US Marketing Manager-Antom
description:
About the Role
We are reinventing what B2B growth looks like, pushing traditional boundaries to scale our enterprise presence across the US market. As a US Growth & Marketing Specialist, you will sit at the intersection of demand generation, account-based marketing (ABM), and offline campaign execution.
This is a high-visibility, high-autonomy role designed for a "builder" who brings a unique blend of analytical rigor, creativity, and a hands-on execution mindset. You will own the strategy and execution of high-touch marketing programs designed to accelerate the sales cycle, deepen partner ecosystems, and convert high-value accounts through immersive, localized brand experiences.

What You’ll Do
● Targeted Campaign Architecture: Design, build, and execute end-to-end multi-channel campaigns—with a heavy emphasis on account-based marketing (ABM) and offline experiential marketing—to drive enterprise pipeline.
● High-Touch Strategic Touchpoints: Own the end-to-end planning and execution of localized customer workshops, partner roadshows, roundtables, and industry ecosystem activations aimed at accelerating deal cycles.
● Ecosystem GTM Execution: Partner with our payments ecosystem—including Independent Software Vendors (ISVs), Independent Sales Organizations (ISOs), core networks, and platforms—to co-market and execute joint marketing programs that expand our US footprint.
● Cross-Functional Sales Alignment: Partner closely with Sales and Business Development leadership to identify high-priority regional markets and enterprise merchant verticals, deploying hyper-targeted marketing programs that unlock processing volume.
● Data-Driven Optimization: Rigorously track and analyze program performance, lead attribution, and pipeline velocity. Use tools like Excel, SQL, and CRM systems to measure marketing ROI and optimize future campaign investments.

What You Bring
● Operational Excellence: A proven track record of managing complex project timelines and high-stakes budgets for offline programs or large-scale campaigns.
● Analytical Polish: Strong proficiency in data analysis with the ability to turn campaign analytics and volume metrics into actionable pipeline strategies.
● Cross-Functional Leadership: Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with a demonstrated ability to align sales teams, external partners, and executive leadership.
● Adaptability: A thriving-in-chaos mindset suited for a fast-paced fintech environment where you must balance strategic thinking with ground-level execution.

What Success Looks Like
● Pipeline & Volume Acceleration: Successfully launching localized, high-touch programs that directly shrink sales cycles and boost processing volume for strategic accounts.
● Seamless Execution: Flawlessly executing a high-volume calendar of offline and ecosystem campaigns on time and within budget.
● Scalable Playbooks: Establishing repeatable marketing playbooks that allow us to scale our regional and partner-led acquisition efforts efficiently across the country.

Qualifications
● Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field
● 3–7 years of experience in growth marketing, demand generation, or strategic operations (experience within payments, acquiring, or fintech is a strong plus, but not a requirement)
● Proven experience planning and executing multi-channel B2B campaigns, localized market activations, or partner-facing programs
● Experience building programs from "0 to 1" at a high-growth startup or in a strategic business operations role preferred
● Strong track record of managing complex project timelines, external vendors, agency relationships, and budgets
● High proficiency in data analysis using Excel (SQL knowledge is a strong plus)
● Experience working with CRM platforms like Salesforce for lead capture, campaign attribution, and pipeline tracking
● Familiarity with the payments ecosystem, merchant acquiring, or integrated payments is a plus

The US base salary range for this full-time position is  $120,000-160,000.  Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Ant International and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and relevant education or training.

title: Ant International-Strategic Partnership Manager-Financial Institutions
description:
We are looking for a Strategic Partnership Manager to develop, manage, and grow strategic payment partnerships for Ant International in the Americas region.
This role is responsible for both establishing new partnerships and managing existing key relationships across the payment ecosystem, including card networks, acquirers, payment gateways, alternative payment methods (APMs), banks, and other financial institutions.

The ideal candidate combines strong business development capabilities with strategic relationship management, commercial acumen, and a results-driven mindset. Success in this role requires strong ownership, effective stakeholder engagement, and the ability to navigate complex internal and external relationships to achieve business objectives.

Key Responsibilities
• Identify, evaluate, negotiate, and establish new partnerships with financial institutions and payment providers to support business expansion and strategic objectives.
• Own and manage relationships with existing strategic payment partners, maintain strong engagement at multiple organizational levels, and drive long-term partnership success.
• Identify opportunities to expand existing partnerships, optimize commercial terms, enhance product capabilities, and drive sustainable business growth.
• Lead commercial and contractual negotiations for both new and existing partnerships, balancing business objectives, partnership value, and long-term strategic interests.
• Analyze partnership performance, transaction trends, pricing structures, and commercial economics to identify opportunities, develop business cases, and drive data-informed decisions.
• Engage and influence internal stakeholders and external partners, align priorities, resolve challenges, and drive cross-functional initiatives to achieve business objectives.
• Collaborate closely with product, engineering, operations, finance, legal, risk, and regional teams, including regular coordination with key stakeholders in Asia, to advance strategic partnership initiatives.
• Monitor the payments ecosystem, competitive landscape, and regulatory developments, translating market insights and partner feedback into actionable business and product strategies.

7+ years of relevant professional experience, including at least 4 years in financial institutions, payment companies, digital wallets, or payment fintech.
• Proven track record in developing new strategic partnerships and managing existing key relationships within the payments industry.
• Strong understanding of the US payments ecosystem, including merchant acquiring, card networks, payment gateways, and alternative payment methods.
• Demonstrated success in complex commercial negotiations, partnership management, and driving business growth.
• Strong analytical skills and business acumen, with the ability to leverage data, evaluate partnership economics, develop business cases, and make sound commercial decisions.
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders, build alignment, and drive execution.
• Results-driven with a strong sense of ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to independently manage complex initiatives and deliver measurable business outcomes.
• Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
• Knowledge of payment regulations, card scheme rules, and cross-border payments is a plus.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Mandarin proficiency is a plus.
• Flexibility to work across global time zones, including regular coordination with key stakeholders in Asia outside standard US business hours.
• Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as business needs require.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is  $150,000-240,000.  Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Ant International and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and relevant education or training.
